messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started — service=embed-svc, version=2026.03-rc2, rollout=canary, target=20%, regions=[eu-west], change_window=23:00-02:00 UTC. @eng-team will monitor. :rocket:

maria: saw the initial canary at ~23:12 UTC. p50 ok, p95 ~12ms above baseline. small 5xx blips (0.02%). leaving dashboards open.

alex: linking dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abcd/embed-svc-p95 — looks like most of the latency is in kv-cache miss rate for eu-west-2 nodes.

sam: running a quick logs query to check backend errors and tailing access logs.

sam: ```
# kql stub
service:"embed-svc" and status >= 500 and timestamp >= now-5m | count()
# => 3 errors across two hosts
```

deploy-bot: Canary traffic at 20%. Health checks passing, but SLO-guard triggered: error_budget_remaining=2.1% (threshold_alert=<=2.5%). Posting alert to thread. :warning:

jules: hmm - error budget low already. Is this a transient noise or a trend?

maria: the p95 bump + those 5xxs are concentrated on a single host pool handling large batched requests. I suspect a scheduling/backpressure regression in 2026.03-rc2.

alex: agree with maria. Suggest pause rollout and pin routing to previous known-good version 2026.03-beta9 for the eu-west region while we triage. We can keep non-eu traffic on rc2 if needed but prefer to limit blast radius.

sam: quick check: roll-forward to 20% increased avg batch size by ~1.5x on eu-west. That could explain KV contention. Adding a short query from metrics: `avg(batch_size) by host` shows two hosts at +60%.

jules: recommendation sounds safe. What's the operational command to pin?

ops-bot: Received pin request. Executing: `routingctl pin --service embed-svc --region eu-west --version 2026.03-beta9 --note "canary pause due to p95/5xx trend"`

ops-bot: Command output:
```
Applying pin... OK
Updating routing table... OK
Target traffic for 2026.03-beta9 now 100% for route /v1/embed in eu-west (canary stopped)
```

ops-bot: Tagging release: https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-5129 (pin + triage)

deploy-bot: Canary paused and routing pinned as requested. Recorded in deploy log: https://deploy.redwood.ai/logs/1759964444. Rolling back rc2 in eu-west to beta9. Canary status: STOPPED.

maria: I'll start a focused triage on kv-cache batching heuristics and throttle path. Sam + Alex can help repro with large batch replay.

alex: I'll hold any further canary expansions and update the release notes with the pin rationale.

sam: creating postmortem/triage ticket now: https://tickets.redwood.ai/ENG-5130 — adding logs and metric snippets.

jules: thanks all. Once triage makes progress we can decide whether to re-roll rc2 with a fix or proceed with rc2 elsewhere. For now, good call to pin. :+1:

deploy-bot: Closing monitoring watch for this thread. If error budget climbs or new alerts fire, thread will reopen automatically. Good catch team.

maria: small follow-up — can someone add a quick blurb to release notes: "Canary paused in eu-west due to transient p95/5xx increase; pinned to 2026.03-beta9 while investigating kv-cache batching." I'll link to ENG-5130.

alex: done: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026.03/notes#canary-pause-eu-west

ops-bot: Locking the change window entry with tag `pin-applied` and notifying infra oncall.

sam: leaving an observation in the k8s deploy dashboard: `embed-svc` pod CPU spikes correlated to batch bursts, saving trace ids in ENG-5130.

jules: ok closing thread, will re-open if we see continued drift. Thanks.
